state.paragraph: On December 10, PetSmart received final bid letters along with revised versions of the merger agreement and other transaction documents from the Buyer Group and from Bidder 2 and a verbal indication from Bidder 3. The Buyer Group offered $80.70 per share, in cash, and Bidder 2 offered $80.35 per share, in cash. Bidder 3 verbally communicated to J.P. Morgan that their valuation would not be above the current stock price of approximately $78 per share. J.P. Morgan communicated to Bidder 3 that it was unlikely to be competitive and accordingly Bidder 3 did not submit a written offer. The form of merger agreement and other transaction documentation submitted by the Buyer Group were more favorable to the Company (including because they were less conditional and more likely to be completed and because they offered more certainty of protection for the Company in the unlikely event of non-completion of the transaction) and reflected substantially more acceptance of the Company's positions. Each bidder indicated that its bid was not dependent on a rollover by Longview, but neither the Buyer Group nor Bidder 2 ruled out the possibility of partnering with Longview in a transaction, though Bidder 2 indicated that any partnering with Longview would only occur after completion of bidding and execution of a definitive merger agreement with the Company.

ledger_rows.Note: Initially set 12/05/2014 for final bids, targeting completion by 12/15/2014.
Moved final-bid deadline from 12/05 to the evening of 12/10 and requested agreement markups and financing commitments in advance if possible.
Final-bid deadline reached; the target received two written final bids and Bidder 3’s verbal indication.
Final cash bid with revised transaction documents; committed financing had been provided on 12/06; documentation was less conditional than Bidder 2’s.
Final cash bid with a revised merger agreement; its documentation was comparatively more conditional than Buyer Group’s.
Verbal whole-company indication; ceiling was approximately the current stock price, not a written final offer.
J.P. Morgan said the valuation was unlikely to compete; Bidder 3 then did not submit the requested written offer. Attribution is flagged.
Required the two remaining bidders to improve by 12/12; treated as an extension within the already announced final round.
Approved Buyer Group’s request to work with Longview; they formed a rollover-support relationship but not a separate bidding group.
Improved-bid deadline; Bidder 2 and Buyer Group submitted revised bids that evening.
Submitted revised agreements and financing commitments; later confirmed $81.50 was best and final.
Oral revision; said it was working to increase the offer within hours. Revised agreements and financing commitments accompanied the final sequence.
Best and final cash offer; revised documents were, with few exceptions, substantially executable and financing commitments were supplied.
Selected Buyer Group and approved its merger, subject to satisfactory resolution of remaining agreement points.
Buyer Group’s $83 offer was selected over Bidder 2’s standing $81.50 best-and-final offer.

bid.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a bidder submits, revises, confirms or reaffirms a priced proposal, indication of interest or offer for the company. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.

exit.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a potential buyer withdraws, declines to bid, is told it will not advance, or is otherwise excluded from the process. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
